Czech drug data inside your AI assistant. No install — add the remote MCP server to your client config:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "sukl": {
      "type": "url",
      "url": "https://sukl-mcp.vercel.app/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Need MKN-10, healthcare providers, reimbursements or PubMed too? Install CzechMedMCP:

```bash
uv tool install git+https://github.com/petrsovadina/CzechMedMCP.git
npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector czechmedmcp run   # browse all 60 tools
```
